visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair wearing a light blue dress holds a gold-colored smartphone in front of her face. The phone displays a video of a white SUV with specialized camera equipment mounted on its roof, driving through a busy urban intersection with several pedestrians in the background. The scene is set indoors with a brown leather sofa and decorative wall paintings. (2) The woman moves the phone closer to the camera to show the text 'Apple Maps Imagery Collection' on the vehicle. She has a cheerful and engaging facial expression, looking directly at the viewer while her hands remain steady on the phone. The background remains the same well-lit indoor living space. (3) The camera cuts to a medium shot of the woman looking surprised with wide eyes and her mouth slightly open. She gestures with her hands as a graphic overlay of a grey Google Street View car appears on the left side of the frame. The background features a sofa with a dog-printed pillow and framed botanical art. (4) In a humorous cut, a green 'angry vein' icon is edited above the woman's head as she looks frustrated and points toward the camera. She then transitions back to a neutral, explanatory pose, gesturing toward a static photo of a man wearing a large blue spherical camera backpack in a sun-dappled forest trail. (5) A screen recording shows the Google Maps interface as someone navigates through a narrow urban alleyway filled with parked scooters and storefronts. The lighting transitions from the indoor studio setting to the digital interface. (6) The woman continues her explanation, pointing to a job listing from the '104' recruitment site with a large orange logo. She uses her hands to emphasize the salary and working conditions. (7) A social media screenshot from 'Threads' is shown, featuring a person in a red shirt carrying a massive, heavy-looking camera rig through a city street. The woman appears again in the final shot, which turns black and white with a frozen expression as large purple text covers her face.

The female voice maintains a friendly and high-arousal tone as she discusses street view cars.
